name: starpulse-board
description: StarPulse's Claude Code mods: the Board and the Sessions list.

plugins.name: starpulse-board
plugins.description: Shows the Board tasks this Claude Code session holds above the prompt, a Board pane of every open lane, and /board to list held tasks. Terminal and Desktop.

plugins.name: starpulse-sessions
plugins.description: A Sessions pane for the terminal dock: every session on the host with the task it holds, click to switch to its tmux session, archive and resume. Terminal and tmux only.
